purpose: Test whether the Myo R1-core and R3 trends reproduce on higher-rate forearm and wrist hardware views before Round 4 personalization.

screen.held_out_subject_selection: Uniformly spaced identifiers across the 43-subject cohort; not selected from model results.

stage_2_confirmation.candidates: At most the top two representations after the paired seed-42 screen.

round_3_gate.r3_reference: the better of R1-core and R2 within each dataset view
round_3_gate.interpretation: A GRABMyo view can support but cannot by itself satisfy the two-dataset R3 retention gate.

limitations: This is a seven-target compute screen, not the full 43-subject GRABMyo benchmark.
The ten-window cap is a declared approximation and must be removed for a final specialist estimate.
Forearm and wrist are correlated views from the same people and do not count as two independent datasets.
No target-subject calibration is used in this screen.
